title: Non-blocking follow-up from PR #227 review (backend-trade-journal-followup-review-followups)
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #227, tracked here so it isn't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: backend-trade-journal-followup-review-followups.json's decisions entry (and PR #227's description) state ClosedTradeOut has grown to '18 fields' -- an AST count of app/api/schemas.py's ClosedTradeOut and a manual field-by-field read of the extracted _to_closed_trade_out helper both show exactly 17 fields (id, ticker, quantity, entry_price, entry_date, exit_price, exit_date, realized_pnl, exit_reason, buy_grade_pct, sell_grade_pct, trade_grade_pct, trade_letter_grade, entry_notes, strategy, follow_up_notes, follow_up_reviewed_at). The helper itself is complete and correct (it covers the real, full field set), so this doesn't affect behavior -- it's purely the decision record's/PR description's stated count that's off by one. Worth correcting the decision entry's wording (or at least noting the discrepancy) so a future reader trying to reconstruct 'which fields were added when' from the decision record isn't misled by the wrong count.
